notes:
Top-line: ZenWave runs contact center for retail chain (120 contact centers), primary pain = seasonal spikes (Black Friday, holiday returns) and incident bursts during promotional outages. Wants agent-assist + fast ticket summarization + tool-calling into internal ticketing via secure APIs. Key quote from Head of Ops: "We need zero-drop during peak windows — if agents are blocked for >30s it cascades."

POC scope agreed: 1) Validate routing/fallback across hosted -> dedicated -> private fallback, 2) Run chaos POC simulating 3x-5x surge and network jitter, 3) Validate SSO + audit log pipeline, 4) Measure token-unit economics at realistic prompt templates.

Technical constraints: Genesys connector must run in VPC, TLS mTLS to internal ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), retention policy: 30 days for conversational logs then archive, data residency: US-only. Prefers model variants that can degrade gracefully (smaller quantized fallback).

Current engagement notes (sales cadence): AE Ava Martin opened, SE Diego leading technical POC, CSM Maya prepping onboarding checklist. Budget flagged at $150k-300k ARR depending on SLA and dedicated capacity. Security requested SOC2 artifacts — we provided partial pack on 2024-11-07 (drive link).

Stitching to Redwood features: interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput during known peaks, Optimize for batching recommendations and KV caching to reduce token cost, Console dashboards for per-route SLOs and burst tracing.

Open items: SAML metadata, final dedicated node count sizing, legal on data residency addendum. Recommended next meeting: planning call + kickoff of chaos POC (agenda attached in drive link).
